summary: Stage 3 (Discover / Search / Atlas) frontend test using simulated controller keyboard events at 1920x1080 and 3840x2160, plus prefers-reduced-motion. WORKS: Discover tab arrows, grid nav (exactly one item or row per press, edges stop, 8 cols at 1080p and 9 at 4K, total 3156), deep focus restore from detail (idx 146 and idx 162, past the 120-item first data page; scrollY restored exactly, URL sort/filter kept), Collections -> collection -> movie -> Back keeps the same card, sort/filter sheets focus-trapped with Escape returning to the button, Nothing-matches empty state. Search: OSK autofocus, row edge stops, OSK Enter/Backspace/Clear/PadX/PadY, physical typing on an OSK key or result ('nor', 'a b', fast burst 'northern') with no duplicates and focus kept in place, Backspace on a result deletes without going back, native typing in the input, Ctrl+A not hijacked, restore of query plus exact episode result after Back. Atlas: rings 2/10/14, Left/Right wrap, Up/Down between rings, Up from inner ring to toolbar, zoom in/out restores the cluster node, PageUp/PageDown with page label, return from detail on page 2 keeps the same title in orbit mode, More-genres group nesting, grid mode persists across reload. Regression OK: Home filmstrip, movie/show detail, player plays and B exits, Settings loads. BROKEN (7 bugs): (1) Discover focus memory is stale inside one mounted Discover page, so entering a collection, going back to the Collections list, changing sort/filters or switching tabs focuses the wrong card or loses focus. (2) The filter sheet re-mounts on every toggle, which resets focus to Done; removing a chip or pressing Reset sends focus to <body>. (3) Search: ArrowRight from the OSK right column does not reach the results, despite the on-screen hint. (4) Atlas grid mode: Back from a title detail focuses the toolbar Back button, not the title. (5) Discover: Up from first-row cards in columns 3-7 jumps to the top nav Library link and skips the filters and tabs. (6) Sheets open with focus on Done, not on the selected option. (7) Initial focus lands on All media even when another tab is selected. Discover All media time to first grid render (3156 titles, cold load via preview URL): about 1.6 s.

ui_bugs.issue: `const [initial] = useState(() => recall(qs))` runs only once per mount. Changing qs inside the same mounted Discover page remounts PosterGrid (key=qs) with a stale initialIndex/initialScroll. Changing qs means opening a collection, going back to Collections, changing sort/filters or switching view tabs. The sessionStorage memory is also a single entry, so the Collections-list position is overwritten once you open a title inside a collection. Observed: (a) opening collection-11 from Collections leaves focus on <body>; (b) collection -> movie -> Back -> Back lands on Collections with collection index 1 focused (the index remembered inside the collection) instead of index 10; (c) after returning from a detail at idx 51, choosing another sort focuses idx 51 of the new order and keeps scrollY 2302, stealing focus from the sort button; (d) switching to the All media tab moves focus from the tab to card idx 1.

On every query change usePagedItems calls setFirst(null), so facets become null. That unmounts and re-mounts the OptionSheet (`sheet && facets &&`) and the facet buttons. Toggling a filter option therefore resets focus to the Done button, which blocks multi-select with a D-pad. After closing the sheet, focus is on <body>. Removing a chip, or pressing Reset filters, also leaves focus on <body> (the chips/button disappear and the grid shows a Loading placeholder). Fix: keep the previous page/facets until the new result arrives; move focus to a stable target (next chip, Genre button, or sort button) after removal or reset.

ArrowRight from the right-column keys (F, L, R, X, 4, 0, Clear) never reaches the results. The .osk-row elements carry data-nav-row, so pickNext keeps Left/Right inside the row and just edge-bounces. The hint says '→ results'. The only D-pad path to the results is Up to the input, then Right (which jumps to the top-nav Search link), then Down. Fix: on a Right edge in the OSK, explicitly focus the first result (or the restored result).

ui_bugs.component: Atlas grid mode return from detail
ui_bugs.issue: Grid mode, cluster Crime, page 2, title movie-305 -> Enter -> Escape: back on page 2 / 4 (correct) but focus is on [data-testid=atlas-back], not the title. Grid MediaCards carry no data-autofocus, Atlas does not call focusSelected() on mount, and NavBridge focusFirst(main) picks the first button. Orbit mode works because star nodes have data-autofocus. Fix: call focusSelected() on mount (or once titles are ready), or pass data-autofocus to the selected MediaCard.

ui_bugs.component: Discover grid Up from first row
ui_bugs.issue: Up from first-row cards in columns 3-7 jumps to the top-nav Library link ([data-testid=nav-settings]) and skips the filter row and the view tabs. Only column 0 reaches the Sort button. Spec: Up from the first row goes to filters/tabs. Fix: add data-nav-up on .dgrid pointing to the sort or last filter button, or limit Up to the filter row.
`querySelector("[aria-pressed='true'], button")` returns the first match in document order, which is always the Done button. The currently selected sort option is never focused on open.
On first load of /discover?view=shows (or any non-default view), autofocus lands on the 'All media' tab, not the selected tab. Pressing A immediately switches the view.

issues: The outer ring's bottom nodes and labels (Test Set 25/30) are clipped. The .atlas-hints bar sits below the fold: scrollHeight 1116 vs 1080; at 4K, 1985 vs 1920. Hint text is only half visible.
The InfoPanel is vertically centred against the tall grid, so its art and text are pushed off-screen (bottom-left).
In grid mode the hints still say 'around the orbit / between orbits'.
The primary nav has no background, so the nav text overlaps the posters while scrolling.
The Type filter is shown inside a movie-only collection (minor).

action_items: Discover: make focus memory per-qs (map or stack keyed by qs in sessionStorage) and recompute the initial index/scroll whenever qs changes. When qs changes without a memory (sort/filter/tab change), do not steal focus from the control. Restore the Collections-list card after Back from a collection.

usePagedItems/FilterBar: do not null out first/facets while the next query loads, so the sheet and buttons stay mounted. Keep focus on the toggled option; after removing a chip or resetting, move focus to a stable neighbour. Never leave focus on body.
Search: ArrowRight on the OSK right edge (and on the wide row) must focus the first result, or the previously focused result.
Atlas grid mode: focus the aria-current card on mount/return (call focusSelected or add data-autofocus to the selected MediaCard).
Discover grid: Up from any first-row card should go to the filter row/tabs (data-nav-up), not the top nav.
OptionSheet: focus the aria-pressed option first, falling back to the first option.
Discover initial autofocus: focus the selected tab.
Atlas layout: fit the sky and hints inside 100vh at 1080p and 4K; fix the InfoPanel position in grid cluster; use grid-specific hint text.
critical_code_review_comments: Discover.tsx: `useState(() => recall(qs))` is a one-shot; qs changes through setParams/navigate on the same route without a remount, so restore state goes stale. This is the root cause of bug 1.
usePagedItems: setFirst(null) on every query change makes facets null, which unmounts FilterBar's sheet and facet buttons and causes the focus loss.
Search.tsx: the FOCUS_KEY entry is never cleared, so a later fresh visit with the same q (e.g. a bookmark) restores an old result. Minor.
Search onPageKey is scoped to .page.search, so typing while focus is on the PrimaryNav does not edit the query. Minor.
Osk.tsx: ROWS hard-coded a-z/0-9; no punctuation keys (', -, :, &) even though the regex accepts them from a physical keyboard. Minor.

seed_data_creation: None. Read-only browsing; no libraries or settings changed. The atlas mode localStorage and sessionStorage were cleared or changed in the test browser only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Discover time to first grid render was about 1.57 s for 3156 titles. Simulate PadX/PadY with dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'PadX',bubbles:true})) on document.activeElement; Playwright keyboard.press cannot send them. Pressing Escape on Discover with no sheet open calls history.back(). Atlas node testids are atlas-node-<id> (orbit) and atlas-gnode-<id> (grid); genre example: atlas-node-genre:Adventure. Retest focus/restore bugs 1-5 first. Empty-library states (discover-empty with no library, atlas-empty) were checked by code reading only.
rca of the issue: Collections/sort focus bugs: Discover is not remounted when only the query string changes (same /discover route); the initial restore state is captured once with useState, and the memory is a single sessionStorage entry. Filter-sheet focus reset: usePagedItems clears first/facets on query change, so the conditional render `sheet && facets` unmounts the dialog. OSK Right: data-nav-row confines Left/Right to the OSK row and edge-bounces. Atlas grid return: there is no programmatic focus of the aria-current item on mount and grid MediaCards have no data-autofocus, so NavBridge's focusFirst(main) picks the toolbar Back button.
